designationHistory.indexText: Cokeville Meadows National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1993 when the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service made its first land purchase.

authority.citation: First land acquisition under an acquisition boundary approved by a 1992 record of decision

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cokeville Meadows National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Cokeville Meadows NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (GovInfo GOVPUB-I49-PURL-gpo56248): "Cokeville Meadows Refuge was established in 1993 with our first land acquisition"; acquisition boundary approved by a 1992 record of decision

review.note: Draft 1967 is wrong; CCP: established 1993 with first acquisition (land table shows Oct. 12, 1993), boundary approved 1992.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: This 23,464-acre Refuge was established in 1967 primarily to provide suitable nesting and rearing habitat for migratory birds.
